scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: You did not ask any diagnostic probing questions about how or where the device was lost or whether Find My was enabled, proceeding straight to barring.

grader.scenario: Handset lost in London; emergency SIM swap and IMEI blacklist request

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care' and closing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' properly stated.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Managed hold announced ('Bear with me for a couple of minutes') and thanked ('Thank you for holding, Beatrice') with no unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified address and 4-digit security PIN within 55 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Naturally addressed customer as Beatrice throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: When customer panicked at [05:23] about banking apps and compromised savings, Agent acknowledged at [05:44]: 'I completely understand how terrifying that thought is, Beatrice. Please take a deep breath.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the request at [02:36]: 'So what I understand is that your phone was lost in London earlier this afternoon, and we need to suspend the SIM card immediately, issue an eSIM replacement for your iPad, and blacklist the handset IMEI on the national database, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any questions. Re-checked device model at [07:18] legitimately before blacklisting.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent executed barring, blacklisting, and eSIM delivery end-to-end.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked no diagnostic probing questions regarding loss circumstances or tracking diagnostics.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed at [10:36] that barring is active, replacement eSIM received in inbox, and all queries are resolved.
